title: What is IEEE Computer Society at VIT?
text: IEEE Computer Society, VIT is a student branch of the Madras Section of IEEE Region 10, formed in February 2012, that organizes technical events, workshops, hackathons, and projects to empower innovation.

title: When was IEEE Computer Society VIT formed?
text: The IEEE Computer Society student branch at VIT was formed in February 2012.

title: Which IEEE region and section does IEEE-CS VIT belong to?
text: It belongs to the Madras Section of IEEE Region 10.

title: What are the key activities of IEEE-CS VIT?
text: IEEE-CS VIT conducts workshops, hackathons, technical talks, mentoring sessions, and also supports projects and research publications.

title: How many hackathons has IEEE-CS VIT conquered?
text: The chapter has conquered 22+ hackathons, including those organized by NASA, AngelHack, and PayPal.

title: What awards has IEEE-CS VIT received?
text: IEEE-CS VIT has been named 'Most Outstanding Student Chapter' twice—in 2017 and 2019 at the All India IEEE Computer Society Student & Young Professional Congress.

title: Have any members of IEEE-CS VIT received scholarships?
text: Yes—3 of its members have received the prestigious Richard E. Merwin Scholarship for their contributions.

title: Has IEEE-CS VIT been involved in international events?
text: Yes—members represented India at CanSat-18 and the European Rover Challenge ’18 organized by the European Space Agency.

title: What kind of research output has IEEE-CS VIT produced?
text: They have published 23 research papers, of which 2 were featured in IEEE journals.

title: What support does IEEE-CS VIT provide to official IEEE events?
text: They supply proactive volunteers to IEEE events such as YESIST12, WIE PBL, IEEE Compute, TechX ’19 (IEEE Kolkata Section), and IEEE IPL.

title: Have IEEE-CS VIT members held leadership roles in other events?
text: Yes—members have served as team leads for events like IEEE CSIS, AICSSYC ’19, and STEP ’20 IEEE Madras Section.

title: Who is the Chairperson of IEEE-CS VIT?
text: The current chairperson is Ram Krishna.

title: Who holds key positions in the IEEE-CS VIT team?
text: Vice Chairperson: Anubhav Batra; Secretary: Aditya Verma; Co-Secretary: Arjun Bector; Technical Head: Ansh Mehta; Projects Head: Akshit Anand; Events Head: Dhriti Sharma; Publicity Head: Varun Shirsath; Design Head: Parth Jadhav; R&D Head: Gouri Kanade; Web Lead: Medhansh Jain; App Lead: Krish Mehta; IoT Lead: Arya Patil.

title: How many hackathon wins has IEEE-CS VIT achieved?
text: IEEE-CS VIT has more than 15 hackathon wins.

title: How many Merwin Scholars has IEEE-CS VIT produced?
text: They have had 3 Merwin Scholars.

title: How many times has IEEE-CS VIT been named Best Chapter?
text: The chapter has received 2 Best Chapter Awards.

title: What is Assignofast by IEEE-CS VIT?
text: Assignofast is a smart app/extension developed by IEEE-CS VIT to help students manage deadlines by syncing assignments and timetable from VTOP and sending timely reminders.

title: How does Assignofast sync assignments?
text: It syncs digital assignments and timetable automatically whenever you log in to VTOP or when a new semester begins.

title: Are submissions on VITian auto-updated on Assignofast?
text: No—a submission via VITian is not automatically reflected; you must log in to VTOP to trigger the update.

title: What features does Assignofast offer for personal task management?
text: It allows adding personal tasks, categorizing them, and setting reminders for both academic and non-academic chores.

title: What is ARCS organized by IEEE-CS VIT?
text: ARCS is the flagship annual event of IEEE-CS VIT, featuring high-energy hackathons and technical hunts like HackBattle and Cicada.

title: What are HackBattle and Cicada in ARCS’24?
text: HackBattle is a 36-hour hackathon, and Cicada 3310 is a technical hunt—both flagship events under ARCS’24 encouraging problem-solving and innovation.

title: When and where were HackBattle and Cicada held in ARCS’24?
text: HackBattle took place on 25–26 September at Anna Auditorium; Cicada 3310 was on 22 September at TT Voc.

title: What was the price for participating in ARCS’24 events?
text: HackBattle had a registration fee of ₹250, while Cicada 3310 was priced at ₹200.

title: Why should one attend ARCS events?
text: They offer electrifying hackathons, keynote sessions, tech challenges, networking, and a fun, high-energy environment to grow technical and Soft skills.

title: Is Hack4Impact free?
text: Hack4Impact is completely free for all participants.

title: What are the problem themes for Hack4Impact?
text: All problem statements for Hack4Impact are based on SDG 4: Quality Education.

title: Who can participate in Hack4Impact?
text: Students from all years are welcome to participate in Hack4Impact.

title: What is the team size for Hack4Impact?
text: Teams for Hack4Impact must have between 2 and 4 members.

title: What are the benefits of Hack4Impact?
text: Participants can gain learning, overcome challenges, collaborate, network, and win SWAGs.

title: Are there prerequisites for Hack4Impact?
text: Coding experience is a plus; however, strong presentation skills and creative ideas are also valued.

title: Will there be refreshments at Hack4Impact?
text: Yes, delicious food and beverages will be provided throughout the event.

title: What is Assignofast?
text: Assignofast is an app/extension developed by IEEE-CS VIT to help manage assignment deadlines by syncing with the VTOP portal.

title: How does Assignofast sync assignments?
text: Assignments and timetables are synced automatically after each VTOP login or when a new semester starts.

title: Do DA submissions via VITian update Assignofast?
text: No—DA submissions via VITian only update Assignofast when you log in to VTOP.

title: Can I use my personal email with Assignofast?
text: No—you must sign in using your VIT email ID.

title: Are personal tasks preserved after reinstalling Assignofast?
text: No—personal tasks are stored locally and will not persist if the app is deleted and reinstalled.

title: What devices support Assignofast?
text: Assignofast is available on Chrome Web Store, App Store, and Google Play.

title: What is HackBattle?
text: HackBattle is a 36-hour hackathon organized by IEEE-CS VIT as part of the ARCS flagship events.

title: What tracks are available in HackBattle?
text: HackBattle features tracks such as Game, Fintech, Healthcare, Open Innovation, SDG, and IoT.

title: Who is the speaker at HackBattle?
text: Mr. Savinder Puri is featured as an industry expert speaker.

title: How do I register for HackBattle?
text: You can register for HackBattle via the official Gravitas website.

title: What is the team size for HackBattle?
text: Team size for HackBattle should be between 3 to 6 members.

title: Can I participate in HackBattle without a team?
text: Yes—unpaired participants will be grouped with others before the event begins.

title: Will there be sessions during HackBattle?
text: Yes—an expert-led tech talk and engaging activities are included during HackBattle.

title: Are there breaks during HackBattle?
text: Yes—scheduled breaks are provided for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

title: What essentials should I bring to HackBattle?
text: Bring your laptop, charger, water bottle, power bank, extension cord, and VIT ID card.

title: Will OD (On Duty) be provided at HackBattle?
text: Yes—participants will receive OD and ID cards will be scanned periodically.

title: Is HackBattle fresher-friendly?
text: Yes—freshers are welcome and mentored by seniors, though seniors do not assist directly with projects.

title: What is ARCS?
text: ARCS is the flagship multi-day event by IEEE-CS VIT, featuring HackBattle and Cicada.

title: When is HackBattle held in ARCS’24?
text: HackBattle was held on 25–26 September at Anna Auditorium.

title: When is Cicada 3310 held in ARCS’24?
text: Cicada 3310 took place on 22 September at TT Voc as part of ARCS’24.

title: What is Cicada 3310?
text: Cicada 3310 is a technical hunt featured as part of the ARCS flagship event.

title: How much does it cost to attend HackBattle?
text: Registration for HackBattle cost ₹250.

title: How much does it cost to join Cicada 3310?
text: Registration for Cicada 3310 cost ₹200.

title: Why should I attend ARCS events?
text: ARCS events offer thrilling hackathons, technical hunts, networking, keynote sessions, and a creative environment.

title: Where can I find IEEE-CS VIT’s GitHub?
text: IEEE-CS VIT hosts 74 repositories on GitHub, including projects like Assignofast and gravitas-premier-league.

title: What kinds of projects are on IEEE-CS VIT’s GitHub?
text: You’ll find various projects including extensions, portals like Core Committee Selection, and frontend/backend systems.

title: Where can I register for HackBattle?
text: You can register for HackBattle on the official Gravitas website.

title: What is the team size for HackBattle?
text: The team size should be between 3 to 6 members.

title: What should I do if I don’t have a team for HackBattle?
text: If you don’t have a team before the event, we’ll pair you with others who also are without a team before HackBattle begins.

title: Will there be any sessions during HackBattle?
text: Yes—there will be a tech talk by an industry expert and some fun activities to keep the energy high!

title: Will there be breaks during the event?
text: Yes—scheduled breaks will be provided for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

title: What should I bring to HackBattle?
text: Be sure to bring your laptop, charger, water bottle, power bank, extension cord, and ID card to stay prepared throughout the event.

title: Will students get OD (On Duty) for attending HackBattle?
text: Yes—students will receive OD, and ID cards will be scanned at regular intervals during the event.

title: Is HackBattle fresher-friendly?
text: Yes—freshers are welcome! Seniors will be available to guide you, though they won’t assist directly with projects.

title: What are the tracks in HackBattle?
text: HackBattle includes tracks such as Healthcare, Fintech, Game Development, IoT, Open Innovation, and SDGs.

title: How long does HackBattle last?
text: HackBattle is a 36-hour continuous hackathon.

title: How are projects judged at HackBattle?
text: Projects are evaluated based on innovation, technical implementation, impact, and presentation.

title: Are there prizes for HackBattle winners?
text: Yes—winners receive cash prizes, goodies, and industry recognition.

title: Do I need to submit code during HackBattle?
text: Yes—final submissions must include source code, documentation, and a demo.

title: Can I work on existing projects for HackBattle?
text: No—all projects must be developed from scratch during the event.

title: What is the judging process at HackBattle?
text: Mentors first shortlist projects, followed by final evaluation by a panel of judges.

title: Are mentors available during HackBattle?
text: Yes—experienced mentors are available to guide participants throughout the hackathon.

title: Does HackBattle allow cross-year teams?
text: Yes—teams can be formed across different years and departments.

title: What is Hack4Impact?
text: Hack4Impact is a hackathon focused on solving social problems with technology, emphasizing SDG goals.

title: What is the main theme of Hack4Impact?
text: Hack4Impact ’24 focuses on UN Sustainable Development Goal 4: Quality Education.

title: How long does Hack4Impact last?
text: Hack4Impact is a 24-hour hackathon.

title: Are there mentors at Hack4Impact?
text: Yes—mentors help teams brainstorm and refine their solutions.

title: Are Hack4Impact projects restricted to software?
text: No—projects can include hardware, software, or hybrid solutions.

title: What are the submission requirements for Hack4Impact?
text: Teams must submit source code, project documentation, and a presentation.

title: Is Hack4Impact competitive or collaborative?
text: It is both—a competition that encourages collaboration and teamwork.

title: Does Hack4Impact provide certificates?
text: Yes—participants and winners receive certificates.

title: Does Assignofast remind about classes?
text: Yes—Assignofast syncs and reminds students about class schedules and assignments.

title: Can I set custom reminders on Assignofast?
text: Yes—users can set personal reminders for deadlines and tasks.

title: Does Assignofast work offline?
text: No—an internet connection is required to sync data from VTOP.

title: Is Assignofast secure?
text: Yes—Assignofast uses your VIT credentials securely to fetch assignments.

title: Does Assignofast support notifications?
text: Yes—notifications alert students about upcoming deadlines.

title: What is ARCS?
text: ARCS is IEEE-CS VIT’s flagship annual fest featuring hackathons, hunts, workshops, and speaker sessions.

title: Does ARCS include workshops?
text: Yes—ARCS hosts hands-on technical workshops across domains like AI, blockchain, and web development.

title: Who are the speakers at ARCS?
text: ARCS invites industry leaders and researchers for keynote talks and panel discussions.

title: Are ARCS events open to non-VIT students?
text: Some events are open to all, while certain competitions may be restricted to VIT students.

title: Can I participate in multiple ARCS events?
text: Yes—participants can register for more than one ARCS event depending on schedule and eligibility.

title: Does ARCS provide networking opportunities?
text: Yes—ARCS allows students to connect with industry professionals and fellow innovators.

title: What are the membership benefits of IEEE-CS VIT?
text: Members gain access to exclusive workshops, research mentorship, project opportunities, and scholarships.

title: How do I join IEEE-CS VIT?
text: Students can join by attending orientation or signing up through the student portal after paying membership dues.

title: Do IEEE-CS VIT members get priority in events?
text: Yes—members often get early access and discounts for events.

title: Does IEEE-CS VIT collaborate with industry?
text: Yes—IEEE-CS VIT frequently collaborates with companies to host talks, hackathons, and mentorships.

title: Can IEEE-CS VIT members publish research?
text: Yes—the society encourages members to publish in IEEE journals and supports research paper writing.

title: How can I contact IEEE-CS VIT?
text: You can reach out via their website contact form, email, or official social media handles.
